sections.text: RIH and landed off THRT, engaged tool and confirmed w/ 2t overpull
Applied pressure to shear pin and then rotated string 8x turns CCW into communication collar
Performed pre-job meeting to pump open me shallow set barrier plug
Dropped 2in steel ball in the well, installed swedge to fig. 1502 connection, installed LTV and cement hose
Pressure tested cement hose and LTV to 20/345bar for 5/10 min. Confirmed line up

Checked annulus pressure at wellhead 10bar. Started to pressure up tubing w/ cement unit with constant rate. Observed pressure drop after reaching 28 bar indicating that plug opened. Stopped pumping, pressure in tubing stabilized at 13 bar. Annulus pressure at wellhead went up and stabilized to 13 bar.

Bled off tubing pressure above DHSV to zero and monitored for buildup, no build up observed. Applied 520bar to the control line to open DHSV. Pressured up well w/ cementing unit. Observed indications of equalizing and openning of DHSV both on cement unit and on pressure gauge on control fluid pump. Stopped pumping. Bled off well to zero pressure. Annulus pressure 2 bar. No indications of gas below DHSV/IN the well observed. Confirmed zero pressure below DHSV. Closed DHSV
RD swedge, LTV and cement hose. Meanwhile held TBT for pulling tubing hanger free
Pressured upthrt line to 2000psi and then bled down to 500 psi to release th
P/u to 166t neutral weight, continued to p/u to 170t, th released overpull). Continued to POOH, observed 20t drag, disconnected control hoses, RIH before start breaking and l/d landing string
L/d landing string and THRT. Meanwhile held TBT for installing power slips and control line reel
Installed power slips and positioned control line reel
POOH w/ 7in tubing from 3034m 3002m
Repaired hydraulic hose for flush mounted slips
Performed pre-job meeting to pull tubing
Continued pulling tubing from 3065m to 2833m. Average pulling speed 4,5 joints/hour
Installed box protector on joint 239 w/ me plug inside. Used crane to lay it out
Continued pulling tubing from 2833m to 2608m. Average pulling speed 7 joints/hour
Removed control line from DHSV, secured same on drum. L/d DHSV using crane. Observed back flow from well. Trip tank static. Waited for backflow to decrease
M/u swedge to casing. Moved control line drum from drill floor
R/d casing tong. Installed clamp on pipe for control line
Changed handling gear to RIH w/ 5,5in DP
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Troubleshoot and changed linear transducer on iron roughneck. Meanwhile built pump in tee and m/u pup joints in fox hole
Started RIH from 2589m. Adjusted clamp, m/u 1st stand
Removed casing slips and installed slips for DP
Continued RIH with back flow to 3050m. M/u TDS on all stands. Average RIH speed 215m/hour
Circulated SW w/ 3000 l/min 155bar. Observed high reading of CO of 90ppm on portable gas sensors in shacker room. Returns OIW was over 100ppm, visually dirty
Stopped pumps, lined up to take returns to MGS, circulated w/ 1000l/min 34bar. Confirmed zero gas readings
Opened BOP, resumed circulation w/ 3000 l/min 155bar. Confirmed OIW content below 30ppm after total of 193m3 circulated
Pumped wash pill of 20m3, 3000 l/min 150 bar
R/b stand, p/u single and pump in assembly
